template_review: All 20 source screenshots were visually inspected; cumulative m00 through m19 match emitted fixture content. Animated spinner excluded from the exact text-region templates.

attempts.reason: External Xlib observer lacked its private Xauthority environment; corrected in the driver.

attempts.limitation: Broad capture region cost and changing layout; raw frames retained, no formal timing acceptance.
Raw region included animated spinner. Its recorded text bytes, excluding spinner, provide visually reviewed templates only.
Endurance run remained concurrent. Full acceptance needs uncontended repeated measurements and all other performance gates.

scope: Exact installed production app operated through XTest on private authenticated Xvfb. Ephemeral scripted HTTP fixture, true composited pixel observation using prebound templates, same monotonic send/receive/capture clock. No JavaScript injection, product binary instrumentation or personal desktop access.
